coverage.label: 20 institutions · MCC UG 2025 Round 1
coverage.summary: A bounded historical dataset of 20 institutions. Official seat matrix and aggregate opening/closing ranks; not an exhaustive national database.
limitations: Only the 20 institutions in the cited one-page AIIMS/BHU/JIPMER seat matrix are included.
Historical ranks describe allotted seats, not admitted or joined candidates.
No verified fee, stipend, bond, score-to-rank curve, previous-year seat or current-vacancy data is bundled.
Other exams have fictional demo records until official records are imported.
Official links are curated; notices and deadlines are not automatically synchronized.

guides.title: Build your list in three passes
guides.body: Start with courses and locations you would actually join. Check eligibility, the counselling authority, fees and any service bond from the relevant official documents. Then order your saved choices by your genuine preference. This workspace does not submit or lock choices on any counselling portal.

guides.title: Read a closing rank carefully
guides.body: A historical closing rank is the highest rank found among published allotments for one course, institution, quota, allotted category, year and round. It is not a guarantee, a current vacancy, a candidate-category cutoff or proof that the student joined. Compare the same pool and check this year’s eligibility and seat matrix.

guides.title: Prepare your documents
guides.body: Use the current official bulletin and the allotted institute’s reporting notice as your checklist. Verify identity, exam records, qualifying certificates and any applicable category, disability or domicile documents. Requirements and validity dates depend on the counselling authority and session.

guides.title: Compare the whole financial commitment
guides.body: Tuition alone is not the full cost. Record hostel and other charges, deposits, the duration of the course, stipend terms, and any service-bond conditions from the institute’s current documents. Unknown fields here are deliberately blank. Demo figures are fictional.

guides.title: Know what is covered
guides.body: The verified dataset contains 20 AIIMS, BHU and JIPMER institutions from MCC’s 2025 Round 1 open-seat matrix and aggregate historical ranks. Other examinations and the fee, stipend, bond, rank-conversion and seat-change examples use clearly marked fictional demo data until you import your own verified records.
